title: Downstream Payment Gateway Timeout Causes Checkout Failures
description: Third-party payment gateway (PayCo) experienced degradation with 30s response times. Checkout service has a 10s timeout, causing all payment attempts to fail. No local code change; entirely external dependency failure.
initial_symptoms: Payment success rate dropped from 99.5% to 12%
PayCo status page shows degraded performance

evidence_catalog.summary: Payment success rate dropped from 99.5% to 12% at 11:00 UTC
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT sum(payment_success) / sum(payment_attempts) FROM payment_metrics WHERE service='checkout-service'
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate payment success rate metrics

evidence_catalog.summary: Checkout service logs show 'PayCo API timeout after 10000ms' for all payment attempts
evidence_catalog.query_reference: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE service='checkout-service' AND message LIKE '%PayCo%timeout%'

evidence_catalog.summary: Trace shows checkout-service calling PayCo /charge endpoint, span duration 10s (timeout), status=error
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will generate trace with external API timeout

evidence_catalog.summary: PayCo API status shows degraded: p99 latency 30s, error rate 5%
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will create dependency status record from external monitoring

evidence_catalog.summary: Checkout service configured with 10s timeout for PayCo calls
evidence_catalog.synthetic_fixture_note: Phase 1/2 will create timeout configuration record

causal_chain.to_description: PayCo API p99 latency 30s exceeds checkout-service 10s timeout

causal_chain.from_description: Checkout failures for all users attempting payment

contributing_factors: Timeout too aggressive for known PayCo variability
No circuit breaker or fallback payment method

misleading_or_confounding_signals: Checkout service error rate high (symptom, not cause)
Recent deployment to checkout-service 2 hours prior (unrelated)

required_checks.description: Verify PayCo status page / API health
required_checks.expected_outcome: PayCo shows degraded with 30s p99 latency

required_checks.description: Confirm trace shows external timeout not local error
required_checks.expected_outcome: Span shows PayCo call duration 10s with timeout error

remediation_guidance.suggestion: Increase PayCo timeout to 35s; add circuit breaker; implement fallback to alternative payment provider
test_plan: Simulate PayCo latency with chaos engineering
remediation_guidance.rollback_plan: Configuration change only; revert timeout if issues
